task.title: Edit raw policies JSON
task.shortdesc: Edit the raw policies.json document with the locally bundled Monaco editor.

prereq.p: Open JSON editor for a saved profile.

context.p: The Monaco editor is bundled locally and edits the raw JSON text. BPM still validates before saving to the normalized profile model.

step.cmd: Place focus in the JSON editor.

info.p: Expected result: the JSON document remains focused on the selected task.

step.cmd: Edit only the policy, preference, or raw value required by the task.

info.p: Expected result: the JSON document remains focused on the selected task.

step.cmd: Keep the top-level policies object and valid JSON syntax.

info.p: Expected result: the JSON document remains focused on the selected task.

step.cmd: Use validation before saving the raw edit.

info.note: Saving raw JSON can change the canonical BPM profile. Validate syntax and policy values before saving.

result.p: The editor contains the intended raw JSON change and is ready for validation.

postreq.p: Recovery: if the edit becomes confusing, format the document or discard changes before saving.
